title: Driver
description: What a driver offers, as data: the element type it serves, what a clip may ask of it and how the element is set up. One file per element type in drivers/. Its implementation lives in the runtimes.

elementType.description: The type of the elements it serves, as .hw files write it (pwm_output); the file is named after it.

capabilities.description: What the element can do in general terms.

conflictPolicy.description: What happens when two sequences on one priority command the element: the latest command wins (lights, relays), or one sequence owns it while it runs (motors, servos). Needed by a driver with actions.

safeState.description: The action the element rests in: when nothing commands it, on stop, on panic. One of its actions that needs no arguments. Needed by a driver with actions.

config.description: The options an element of this type takes in a .hw file, beyond its wiring.

actions.description: What a clip may ask of the element. None for an element that only reads.

driverAction.description: An action of the element, with the parameters a clip gives it.

driverParameter.description: A parameter of an action or an option of an element's configuration: its type, its limits and the value it takes when not given. Without a default it must be given.

min.description: The lowest value allowed (numbers only, with max).

max.description: The highest value allowed (numbers only, with min).
